tools.name: find_furniture_hs_code
tools.description: Suggest international six-digit HS codes (HS 2022, headings 9401, 9402, 9403, 9404) for furniture, seats, mattresses and bedding from a product description in English or Chinese, or from a 4–6 digit code. Returns candidate codes with the conditions for choosing each one, classification notes and off

tools.name: calculate_shipping_cbm
tools.description: Work out shipping volume and container size for furniture. Either give carton dimensions (cartons) to get CBM, cubic feet, air volumetric and chargeable weight and sea LCL revenue tons, or give the volumes several suppliers quoted (supplier_volumes_m3) to add them up. Both suggest LCL, a 20GP or a 4
